defects.description: The source prints „За фиг. 3б:“ a second time where „За фиг. 3в:“ is meant (the dispersing-lens case). The candidate preserves it verbatim, which is correct, but does not note the source error.

Problem 3 Part 1 has no answer object for the three sub-cases (а/б/в); the official solution page 2 contains the per-case answers (действителен/събирателна, недействителен/събирателна, недействителен/разсейвателна + constructions). Not an error of content, but an answer field that could be populated.
All 13 figure crops checked: figs 1а/1б/1в, 2а/2б, 3а/3б/3в/3г and solutions figs 4а/4б/4в/5 each contain the complete drawing with axis labels, lettering and no swallowed body text or clipped edges.
